source.name: Sevilla FC: 'EL SEVILLA FC SE VUELCA CON LA FUNDACIÓN 1890 Y SU RETO'
source.quote: El Sevilla FC portará en su camiseta en el arranque de LALIGA 2026/27 el logo de su Fundación 1890, en lo que será un impulso decisivo para su Reto solidario en el Polígono Sur.
source.note: Score and Change's 2026/27 La Liga sponsor overview lists the front shirt sponsor as 'Sevilla Fundación 1890* Charity' and its prose says 'A day before their opening match, Sevilla announced their charity Fundación 1890 as shirt sponsor.' (https://www.scoreandchange.com/la-liga-sponsors/)

source.name: Score and Change, Overview of the 2026/2027 La Liga sponsors
source.note: Kit-maker table row; the article adds 'After the relegation of Oviedo, the German brand now sponsors two sides: Real Madrid and Sevilla.' The same overview lists no sleeve sponsor for Sevilla ('Sevilla – –') and no back or shorts sponsor.

summary: Home shirt 2026/27: adidas kit, Fundación 1890 (the club's own charity) on the front from the start of the season; no sleeve, back or shorts sponsor per Score and Change's La Liga overview.

change.text: Fundación 1890, the club's own charity, replaces Midea on the front.
